goal: Fix CLI check regression: lint() validated the discovered config against the filtered rule subset, so 'slop check <family>' raised 'configures unknown rule' for any configured rule outside the subset (exposed by config discovery finding an ancestor .slop.toml that configures hotspots). Fix: lint() always loads/validates AnalysisConfig against the full RULE_REGISTRY, and dispatches only the passed subset.

summary.title: Fix check: validate config against full registry, dispatch subset
summary.what: lint() now loads/validates AnalysisConfig against the full RULE_REGISTRY and dispatches only the passed rule subset, so `slop check <family>` no longer raises on an ancestor config that configures out-of-subset rules. Regression test. Suite 188.
summary.why: Config discovery (walking up to ancestor configs) exposed that check's subset-validation rejected validly-configured rules outside the checked family.
summary.user_goal: Fix CLI check regression: lint() validated the discovered config against the filtered rule subset, so 'slop check <family>' raised 'configures unknown rule' for any configured rule outside the subset (exposed by config discovery finding an ancestor .slop.toml that configures hotspots). Fix: lint() always loads/validates AnalysisConfig against the full RULE_REGISTRY, and dispatches only the passed subset.

decisions.chose: Always validate against the full registry; dispatch the subset
decisions.rationale: A configured rule outside the dispatched subset is still a known rule; subset-validation conflated 'not dispatched' with 'unknown'.
rejected: Make unknown-rule a warning (weakens the deliberate typo-catching load error)
